description: Kisetsu v1.2.0 — lyrics margins, simpler style options, player polish and full rebrand to Kisetsu.

changelog.title: Player & lyrics
items: Added comfortable side margins to the animated lyrics so letters are never clipped
Only BitChord and Simple lyrics styles remain available
Tap the mini album cover to close lyrics with animation
Added Apple-style vertical grab handle and small Playing from caption
Floating white quality badge showing only High Quality or Lossless

changelog.title: Home & settings
items: Removed floating shuffle and voice buttons from Home
Removed Home filter tabs and tightened the layout
White settings icons with no tile background, tighter spacing
Accent colours changed from red to iOS blue

changelog.title: Identity & updates
items: Renamed the app and all user-facing branding to Kisetsu
Slightly zoomed out the app icon, still centred
In-app updates now point at this GitHub repository

changes: Lyrics margins, simpler styles, player polish, Kisetsu rebrand
